text: Evening. Im looking after my grandson Alfie tonight, hes 3, his mum and dad are away til tomorow. Two things I want to run past someone. First, since about teatime he has not wanted the big light on at all. He keeps putting his hands over his eyes and told me the light hurts them. I've got just the hall lamp on now and hes a bit happier with that. Second, when I was changing him into his pyjamas I noticed some little spots on his tummy and a couple on his legs, tiny dark red dots like pin pricks and one bigger purplish patch. I rememberd the glass thing from the telly so I pressed the side of a tumbler on them and they didnt go away, you could still see them clear as anything through the glass. I did it twice to be sure. They werent there this morning when I gave him his bath, I'd have noticed. He's been off colour since yesterday. I'm not one to panic but I'd rather ask than sit here wondering. What should I be doing with him.
